textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Heat Transfer in Nature · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: In conduction, thermal energy passes from a warmer region to a cooler region without bulk movement of the material. Conduction is easy to observe along a solid metal spoon.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: In conduction, thermal energy passes from a warmer region to a cooler region without bulk movement of the material. Conduction is easy to observe along a solid metal spoon. Metals are good conductors.
beats.speakEn: In conduction, thermal energy passes from a warmer region to a cooler region without bulk movement of the material. Conduction is easy to observe along a solid metal spoon. Metals are good conductors.

beats.en: Convection transfers energy as a liquid or gas moves. In a common classroom example, warmed water tends to rise and cooler water can sink, setting up a circulation. This is why a room heater warms a room: warm air rises.
beats.speakEn: Convection transfers energy as a liquid or gas moves. In a common classroom example, warmed water tends to rise and cooler water can sink, setting up a circulation. This is why a room heater warms a room: warm air rises.

type: Key Concept: In conduction, thermal energy passes from a warmer region to a cooler region without bulk
Rule: Convection transfers energy as a liquid or gas moves.

textbookBox.concept: Radiation is heat travelling as waves, with no material needed. The warmth of the Sun reaches Earth through empty space.

beats.en: Radiation is heat travelling as waves, with no material needed. The warmth of the Sun reaches Earth through empty space.
beats.speakEn: Radiation is heat travelling as waves, with no material needed. The warmth of the Sun reaches Earth through empty space.

beats.en: On a typical sunny coast, land warms faster than the sea and a sea breeze can blow toward land. At night the land may cool faster and a land breeze can blow toward the sea.
beats.speakEn: On a typical sunny coast, land warms faster than the sea and a sea breeze can blow toward land. At night the land may cool faster and a land breeze can blow toward the sea.
